description: Nuestro equipo utiliza datos e imágenes satelitales de la NASA para ayudar a los agricultores a tomar mejores decisiones. Analizamos información sobre el clima, la humedad del suelo y el estado de los cultivos para ofrecer recomendaciones que mejoren la producción, reduzcan pérdidas y promuevan una agricultura más eficiente y sostenible.
summary: J.A.S.E is a web-based platform that helps farmers make informed decisions using satellite data, geospatial analysis, and artificial intelligence. The system integrates environmental information such as vegetation health, soil moisture, temperature, and rainfall into maps powered by ArcGIS Online.
details:
Our project is a web platform that helps farmers access and understand geographic and environmental data through interactive maps. Using ArcGIS Online, we created maps that display relevant agricultural information, while HTML and CSS were used to develop a simple and user-friendly website.

The platform allows users to explore data visually, making it easier to identify trends and support agricultural planning. Its main benefits include improving access to information, supporting better decision-making, and promoting more efficient farming practices.

The intended impact is to help farmers make informed decisions that can increase productivity and sustainability. What makes our project creative is the combination of GIS technology and web development to transform complex geographic data into an accessible and interactive experience. During development, our team focused on usability, accessibility, reliability, and the practical needs of farmers.
